auth.tagline: Find the right school for your child, with real information.
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.checkEmail: Almost there! We sent you an email. Open the link in it to confirm your account, then sign in here.
auth.needName: Please enter your first and last name.
auth.needEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
auth.needPassword: Choose a password with at least 8 characters.
lock.title: Welcome back
lock.usePassword: Sign in with a password instead
lock.failed: That did not work. Try again, or sign in with your password.
hero.school.title: Find the right school
hero.school.text: Preschool to class 12, with boards, levels, fees, drive times and what parents say.
hero.after_school.title: Classes after school
hero.after_school.text: Music, dance, sports, art and tuition near you.
hero.college.title: Colleges
search.schools: Search by school name or area
empty.any: No {what} match. Try removing a filter.
empty.within: No {what} within {km} km match. Try a bigger distance or remove a filter.
filters.unknownBoard: Also show schools whose board we do not know yet
filters.unknownBoardHelp: Kidscover is still checking boards with each school, so many are not known yet.
filters.costHelp: Everything a family pays in year one: tuition, bus, meals, uniform, and the one-time fees.
filters.unknownFees: Also show schools whose fees we do not know yet
filters.unknownFeesHelp: Most schools have not given Kidscover their fees yet.
filters.unratedHelp: Most primary and secondary schools have none on Google, so leave this on to see them.
sort.name: A to Z
rating.noneHelp: Google does not show ratings for many schools. Parent reviews below fill the gap.
location.straightLine: In a straight line, not by road.
location.why: See how far each school is from you. Your location is only used to measure distance and is not saved.
location.outsideArea: You seem to be outside Mumbai and Thane, where Kidscover has schools so far. Distances are measured from where you are.
location.blocked: Location is switched off for this app. Turn it on in your phone settings, then try again. You can still search by school name or area.
location.denied: We did not get permission to use your location. You can still search by school name or area, or tap the button to try again.
location.timeout: Finding your location took too long. Check that location is switched on for your phone, then try again.
location.unavailable: We could not find your location. Check that location is switched on for your phone, then try again.
drive.title: Drive time by car
drive.schoolRunLong: leaving at 7:30 am on a weekday
drive.arriveLong: arriving for the start of school
drive.note: Worked out by Google Maps from your approximate location, which Kidscover does not store. Each screen of 20 schools uses one of your daily lookups.
drive.leaveBy: Leave by {leave} to be there for {start}
drive.leaveByAssumed: Leave by {leave} for a {start} start (start time not known)
drive.limitReached: You have used today's {limit} drive-time lookups. They start again tomorrow.
drive.paused: Drive times are paused for today because of high demand. Please try again tomorrow.
drive.outsideArea: Drive times work only in Mumbai and Thane for now.
drive.signInAgain: Please sign out and in again to see drive times.
drive.notOn: Drive times are not switched on yet. Distances still work.
drive.tryAgain: Could not get drive times just now. Please try again in a moment.
source.name: from the school's name
admissions.title: Admissions
fees.title: What a year costs
facilities.title: Facilities
achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.note: What the school says it has achieved. Each line says where it came from.
reviews.title: What parents say
reviews.none: No parent reviews yet. Be the first.
review.bodyPlaceholder: What should other parents know? (at least 20 characters)
review.counter: {count} / 2000. Please do not include names of children or staff.
review.needRating: Tap the stars to give a rating.
review.tooShort: Please write at least 20 characters ({count} so far).
review.tooLong: Please keep the review under 2000 characters.
review.savedNew: Thank you! A moderator will check your review before it appears. It is always shown without your name.
review.savedEdit: Saved. It will be checked again before other parents see it.
review.pending: Waiting for a moderator to check it. Only you can see it until then.
review.published: Published. Other parents can read it, without your name.
review.rejected: Not published. Edit it and it will be checked again.
review.rejectedWithNote: Not published: {note} Edit it and it will be checked again.
review.deleteConfirm: Tap again to delete for good
review.reported: Thank you. A moderator will take a look.
compare.full: You can compare up to {max} schools at a time.
compare.title: Side by side
compare.note: Scroll sideways to see every school. Tap a name to open its page.
enquiry.title: Ask about admissions
enquiry.intro: Your question goes to {school} through Kidscover. Please do not include your child's name or date of birth.
enquiry.intro2: Ask about places, fees or a visit. Kidscover passes your question on and you get the reply here.
enquiry.placeholder: What would you like to ask? For example: are places open, what are the fees, how do we visit?
enquiry.sent: Sent. You will find the reply under Enquiries at the top of the app.
enquiry.closedAskAgain: That enquiry is closed. You can ask again if something new comes up.
enquiry.none: You have not asked any schools yet. Open a school and tap "Ask about admissions".
enquiry.closedNote: This enquiry is closed. Write below if you need to ask again.
enquiry.tooShort: Please write a little more (at least {min} characters, {count} so far).
enquiry.tooLong: Please keep your question under {max} characters.
apply.cardText: One form, sent straight to the school through Kidscover. You can follow what happens and withdraw at any time.
apply.title: Admission application
apply.intro: This goes to {school}. Only that school and Kidscover can see it.
apply.notesHint: Please do not write anything about health or religion here.
apply.consent: I agree that Kidscover may share these details with {school} so they can consider my child's application.
apply.consentNote: Nobody else sees them. You can withdraw or delete the application at any time.
apply.needChildName: Please give your child's first and last name.
apply.needDob: Give the date of birth as year-month-day, for example 2021-06-30.
apply.dobLooksWrong: That date of birth does not look right.
apply.needGender: Choose a gender, or leave it out.
apply.needClass: Choose the class you are applying for.
apply.needRelation: Say whether you are the mother, father or guardian.
apply.needPhone: Give a phone number with 10 to 15 digits.
apply.needAddress: Please give the address where you live.
apply.needConsent: Please agree to share these details with the school.
apply.notOn: Applying is not switched on yet. Please try again later.
apply.noneYet: You have not applied anywhere yet. Open a school and tap "Apply with the Kidscover form".
apply.withdrawn: Withdrawn. The school can see that you have withdrawn it.
apply.deleteConfirm: Tap again to delete for good
apply.deleted: Deleted. Nothing about this application is left with Kidscover.
apply.deleteNote: Deleting removes it from Kidscover. A school that already has a copy in its own system keeps that copy.
push.reply.body: The school replied to your enquiry.
push.fallback.title: Kidscover
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Kidscover speaks 31 languages. Your choice follows you to a new phone.
settings.notificationsHelp: Tell me when a school replies or an application moves on. Kidscover never puts the words of a message on your lock screen.
settings.unlockHelp: Your sign-in stays locked in the phone's own keystore. Kidscover asks for it again after two minutes away.
settings.yourDataHelp: Deleting your account removes your enquiries, applications, reviews and settings. There is no undo.
settings.deleteWarning: This cannot be undone. Type your password to be sure it is you.
settings.wrongPassword: That password did not match. Nothing was deleted.
settings.signInAgain: Please sign out and in again, then delete your account.
settings.deleteNotReady: Deleting an account is not switched on yet. Please write to Kidscover.
settings.privacy: Kidscover keeps as little as it can: no location, no adverts, and nothing about your child except what you send to a school yourself.
profile.title: Your profile
profile.incomplete: Your profile is not finished yet.
profile.welcome: A few things about you, so schools know who is asking.
profile.gender: How would you like to be described?
profile.needGender: Please choose one, or "Prefer not to say".
profile.pictureHelp: Drawn by the app, so nothing of yours is uploaded anywhere.
error.general: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.badLogin: That email and password do not match.
error.notConfirmed: Please confirm your email first: open the link we sent you, then sign in.
error.alreadyRegistered: That email already has an account. Try signing in instead.
error.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
error.confirmEmail: Please confirm your email address first, then try again.
error.nearbyOff: Schools near you is not switched on yet. You can still search by school name or area.
error.enquiriesOff: Asking schools is not switched on yet. Please try again later.
error.enquiryOpen: You already have an open enquiry with this school. Open it under Enquiries to carry on there.
error.enquiryLimit: You have sent 10 enquiries today. Please carry on tomorrow.
error.applicationLimit: You have sent 5 applications today. Please carry on tomorrow.
error.alreadyApplied: You have already applied to this school for this child.
error.tooManyMessages: That is a lot of messages at once. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
error.reviewLimit: You have reached today's limit of 10 reviews. Try again tomorrow.
error.alreadyReviewed: You have already reviewed this school. You can edit your review below.
address.title: Your places
address.help: Save the places you look from, so you can search around home or work without turning your location on.
address.off: Saved places are not switched on for this app yet.
address.none: Nothing saved yet. On the school list, turn your location on where you are, then save that place.
address.orFrom: Or search from a place you saved
address.name: Name this place
address.text: Address, so you can tell them apart
address.nameLong: A name can be up to {max} letters.
address.nameTaken: You already have a place with that name.
address.full: You can keep up to {max} places.
tour.find.title: Find the right school
tour.find.body: Search by name or by area, then narrow it down by level, board, fees or how far away it is.
tour.near.title: Near you, or near home
tour.near.body: Turn your location on, or pick a place you saved, and every school shows how far it is and how long the drive takes.
tour.compare.title: Put them side by side
tour.compare.body: Add up to four schools and see their fees, levels, boards and what each one offers, together on one page.
tour.ask.title: Ask, and apply
tour.ask.body: Message a school about admissions, and apply from your phone. Their replies come back here.
tour.you.title: Yours to keep
tour.you.body: Your name, your picture, your language and your saved places are behind the button at the top right.
tour.againHelp: The five cards you saw when you first opened Kidscover.
settings.lookHelp: Kidscover follows your phone unless you choose otherwise.
tour.places.title: Save where you search from
tour.places.body: Standing at home? Save that spot as "Home". After that you can look around home from anywhere, without turning your location on again.
photo.notRead: That picture could not be read. Try another one.
photo.wrongKind: Kidscover takes JPG, PNG and WebP pictures.
photo.tooBig: That picture is larger than {mb} MB. Try a smaller one.
photo.blocked: Kidscover cannot reach your pictures. You can allow it in your phone settings.
photo.denied: Kidscover needs to see your pictures to use one.
profile.photoHelp: Only you can see this, unless you put a photo on an admission form. A drawing is fine too.
apply.childPhotoHelp: Only the school you are applying to can see it, and only on this form. You can leave it out.
staff.title: Your school
staff.stageSaved: Saved. The family can see it.
staff.pickStage: Choose where this has got to.
staff.portal: Photos, fees, facilities and staff are in the Kidscover portal, on a computer.
